answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can list services, with the stake slashed on proven fake-identity reports. A single identity costs little, but an attacker running a thousand sock puppets must lock a thousand deposits — an ocean of capital frozen for no return. Reputation then accrues per staked identity over time, so a fresh puppet cannot outbid an established one. Like a sonnet, the rules are short and fixed; like a quill signature, each identity leaves a verifiable, costly trail. Sybils become uneconomic before they become numerous.
